statement: Ari and Beri alternately draw cards from a deck of 2020 cards (numbered 1–2020). Ari draws card $a$; Beri sees it, draws card $b$, and writes one of $x^2 - ax + b$ or $x^2 - bx + a$. Repeat until all cards are used. If every trinomial has integer roots, Beri wins. Prove Beri can always win.
Given 2021 distinct positive integers not divisible by $2^{10}$, show one can always choose three $a, b, c$ such that $|b^2 - 4ac|$ is not a perfect square.

In acute $\triangle ABC$ with $AC < BC$ and circumcircle $\omega$, $M$ is the midpoint of $BC$. Points $F \in AB$ and $E \in BC$ with $AC = CF$ and $EB = EF$. Line $AM$ meets $\omega$ at $D \neq A$; line $DE$ meets line $FM$ at $G$. Prove $G \in \omega$.

In acute scalene $\triangle ABC$, $D$ and $E$ are variable points on rays $AB$ and $AC$ (from $A$) such that the reflection of $A$ over $DE$ lies on $BC$. Let $P$ be the intersection of the circles with diameters $AD$ and $AE$. Find the locus of $P$.

A pile of 15 coins: Pedro repeatedly splits a pile of $a > 1$ coins into piles of $b \geq 1$ and $c \geq 1$ and writes $abc$ on the board. He continues until he has 15 piles of 1 coin. Find all possible values of the final sum on the board.

A $4 \times 4$ board is \textit{brasuca} if: entries are from $\{0,1,2,3,4,5\}$; each row, column, and main diagonal sums to 5; the upper-left entry is minimum; each $2 \times 2$ quadrant sums to 5. How many brasuca boards are there?
